title: SpaceX and Tesla talk, and the tools of the day move with them
dek: Merger talks would join a rocket company, a car company and the lab behind Grok, while Claude sits in on meetings, Detroit posts a rare line and X widens a post.

lead.head: SpaceX talks about absorbing Tesla
text: Bloomberg reports that SpaceX and Tesla are negotiating a combination that could be announced in December, with the talks now on price and control. Electrek, citing that report, says both boards formed special committees in October, that the structure under discussion has SpaceX absorbing Tesla, and that one open question is how to separate Tesla's China business. Tesla shares rose as much as {gain}. Neither company has commented. The report rests on unnamed sources.

SpaceX bought xAI earlier this year, and xAI makes Grok. This site is built with Claude and Grok. Coverage says that if it happens, it would be the largest corporate deal on record, joining a rocket maker, a car maker and an AI lab under one owner. Tesla's annual shareholder meeting is on December 3. Nobody has confirmed the talks.

notes.head: Claude shows up on the call
notes.text: Anthropic is rolling Claude Meetings out in beta on Team and Enterprise plans, for now only on Google Meet. It shows up as a visible participant, posts a notice in the chat, and builds documents and whiteboards while people talk. If people from outside the company are on the call, it joins only when administrators have allowed it, and it leaves if an outside guest joins later. This site is built with Claude and Grok.

notes.head: Six models and a chip the rules bar
notes.text: Will DePue, a former OpenAI researcher posting as Unemployment Labs, says six open-weight Chinese models started on Nvidia Blackwell chips that US export rules bar from China. He says he searched more than {searched} combinations and estimates {gpus_low} to {gpus_high} chips for the largest runs. He says OpenAI and Anthropic researchers verified it, with no outside reviewer named. Nvidia, DeepSeek, Moonshot, MiniMax and Ant Group had not commented. He says the method does not show a law was broken.

notes.head: Cade Cunningham, and no turnovers
notes.text: The NBA account says Detroit beat its opponent in double overtime and that Cade Cunningham scored {points} points with {assists} assists and no turnovers. It says he is the first player to do that since {since}.

notes.head: One post can hold a short album
notes.text: PopCrave says X raised the limit on photos and videos in one post from {before} to {after}. A feed built around a tight stack now has room for a short sequence, and the scroll gets longer with it.

text: The day adds up to ownership and access. SpaceX, which already owns the lab behind Grok, is talking about absorbing Tesla, and Anthropic is putting Claude on the call as a visible participant. This site is built with Claude and Grok.

Detroit got a scoring line the league says is the first since {since}, and X now lets one post hold {after} photos and videos, up from {before}. The market, the build, the game and the feed moved together.
